name: financials_analyze_financial_transactions
description:
Analyzes Amazon SP-API financial transactions from neonpanel_iceberg.financial_transactions into the same summary_class / summary_subclass label set used by Amazon payment summary reports (Date Range / Custom Unified Summary).

Use this tool when the user wants to reconcile a payment/summary report against financial_transactions, or to summarize a company's Amazon money flows by Income / Expenses / Tax / Transfers.

KEY FACTS the agent must respect:
1. AMAZON REPORTS ARE PER-MARKETPLACE. Amazon publishes summary reports for ONE marketplace at a time, in that marketplace's LOCAL currency (Amazon.com -> USD, Amazon.ca -> CAD, Amazon.de -> EUR, ...). To reconcile a report, ALWAYS set filters.marketplaces to that single marketplace, e.g. ['US'].
2. REPORT PERIODS ARE MARKETPLACE-LOCAL TIME. report_months / start_date / end_date filter on the marketplace-local calendar (US & CA = Pacific, UK = London, EU = CET, JP = Tokyo, AU = Sydney) and line up with Amazon's report periods. Note: a calendar month reconciles to ~99.8% (transactions straddling the month boundary land on different sides); a single day usually reconciles exactly; Transfers always reconcile exactly.
3. CURRENCY. Every output row carries its local currency. Rows are grouped per (class, subclass, currency) - NEVER add debits/credits/net_amount across rows with DIFFERENT currency values; that mixes currencies. To aggregate across marketplaces/currencies, pass filters.consolidation_currency (3-letter ISO, e.g. 'USD'): each line is then also converted at its posted-day rate from neonpanel_iceberg.currency_rates (local -> USD -> target), returned as net_amount_consolidated, which IS safe to sum across all rows. Choosing the consolidation currency: use the company's main currency (account_list_companies returns currency per company) or ask the user which currency to consolidate in. If fx_missing_lines > 0 on any row, some lines had no FX rate for their currency/date (e.g. JPY may lack rates) - their amounts are EXCLUDED from net_amount_consolidated; tell the user instead of presenting the consolidated total as complete.

Reconciliation workflow (single marketplace report):
1. Extract company_id, marketplace, and period from the uploaded report
2. Call this tool with filters.company_id, filters.marketplaces (one marketplace, e.g. ['US']), and filters.report_months e.g. ['2026-03'] (or start_date/end_date for day ranges)
3. Compare the report's Income / Expenses / Tax / Transfers lines against summary_class + summary_subclass totals (same local currency - no conversion needed)
4. Persist the comparison with financials_save_financial_transaction_reconciliation_result using reconciliation_source='financial_transactions'

Multi-marketplace / consolidated view workflow:
1. Determine the consolidation currency (company main currency via account_list_companies, or ask the user)
2. Call with filters.marketplaces listing the marketplaces (or omit for all) AND filters.consolidation_currency
3. Sum net_amount_consolidated across rows (group by summary_class/subclass as needed); report per-currency local figures from the per-row currency column when detail is wanted

Output: one row per (summary_class, summary_subclass, currency). debits = sum of negative source amounts, credits = sum of positive source amounts, net_amount = debits + credits (LOCAL currency of that row), net_amount_consolidated = same lines converted to consolidation_currency (NULL when not requested), fx_missing_lines = lines excluded from conversion for lack of a rate, line_count = source lines in the row.

Knowledge base: https://help.neonpanel.com

BOOKKEEPING METHOD: this is the ACCRUAL-method source (transactions recognized on posted date). It is also correct for cash-method reporting of Amazon activity by posted period; statement-based tools (financials_analyze_amazon_statement, financials_list_amazon_statements, financials_classify_amazon_statement_transactions, financials_list_unmapped_statement_transactions) are for the CASH method only.

filters.description: Compatibility alias for query.filters. Prefer query.filters.

sort.description: Compatibility alias for query.sort. Prefer query.sort.

limit.description: Compatibility alias for query.limit. Prefer query.limit.

query.description: Query envelope for financial transactions reconciliation analysis.

filters.description: Filters for the query. company_id is required; report_months is strongly recommended for reconciliation.

report_months.description: Monthly partitions to include, YYYY-MM, in the MARKETPLACE-LOCAL report timezone (US/CA=Pacific, UK=London, EU=CET, JP=Tokyo, AU=Sydney). Use one value for a monthly report, e.g. ['2026-03']. Matches Amazon's monthly summary period.

marketplaces.description: Optional filter by marketplace. Accepts a country code (US, CA, MX, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE, PL, BE, TR, EG, SA, AE, IN, SG, JP, AU), a marketplace_name ('Amazon.com', 'Amazon.co.uk'), or a marketplace_id ('ATVPDKIKX0DER'). Amazon's unified reports are per-marketplace, so set this to scope to a country report, e.g. ['US'].

marketplace_codes.description: Optional alias for marketplaces. Accepts country codes, marketplace names, or marketplace IDs just like marketplaces.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start day (YYYY-MM-DD) filtered on posted_date_day (marketplace-local calendar day). Use with end_date for a day-range/daily report, e.g. start_date=end_date='2026-05-01'.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD) filtered on posted_date_day (marketplace-local calendar day).

consolidation_currency.description: Optional 3-letter ISO currency (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). When set, each line is also converted at its posted-day FX rate (neonpanel_iceberg.currency_rates, USD-base) and returned as net_amount_consolidated - the only figure safe to sum across rows with different currencies. Pick the company's main currency (see account_list_companies) or ask the user. Required for meaningful multi-marketplace totals.

summary_classes.description: Optional filter by summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, Transfers. Case-insensitive exact match.

summary_subclasses.description: Optional substring filter by summary subclass, e.g. 'FBA transaction fees' or 'Product sales'. Case-insensitive.

field.description: Column to sort by. Default preserves the payment summary report order.

class_order.description: Display order of the top-level summary class.

subclass_order.description: Display order within the summary class.

summary_class.description: Summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, or Transfers.

currency.description: Local (marketplace) currency of this row. Rows are grouped per currency - NEVER sum debits/credits/net_amount across rows with different currency values.

debits.description: Sum of negative source amounts for this subclass, in the row's local currency.

credits.description: Sum of positive source amounts for this subclass, in the row's local currency.

net_amount.description: Net amount (debits + credits) in the row's LOCAL currency. Only comparable/summable within the same currency.

consolidation_currency.description: Echo of filters.consolidation_currency (null when not requested).

net_amount_consolidated.description: Net amount converted line-by-line to consolidation_currency at each line's posted-day FX rate. Safe to sum across ALL rows regardless of local currency. Null when consolidation_currency was not requested.

fx_missing_lines.description: Lines excluded from net_amount_consolidated because no FX rate existed for their currency/date. If > 0, the consolidated total is incomplete - tell the user.

line_count.description: Number of source rows contributing to this subclass.

examples.title: Reconcile a US monthly summary report
examples.description: Amazon summary reports are per-marketplace and in local currency, so scope to ONE marketplace. Totals come back in USD (Amazon.com's local currency) - compare directly against the report's Income/Expenses/Tax/Transfers lines.

examples.title: Reconcile a single-day report
examples.description: Day filters use the marketplace-local calendar (posted_date_day), matching Amazon's daily report window exactly.

examples.title: All marketplaces consolidated to one currency
examples.description: Multi-marketplace data mixes currencies (USD, CAD, EUR, ...). Pass consolidation_currency - the company's main currency from account_list_companies, or ask the user - and sum net_amount_consolidated across rows. Local figures stay per-currency in each row. Check fx_missing_lines = 0 before presenting the total as complete.

examples.title: Only fee lines for one marketplace
examples.description: Return only expense subclasses containing 'fee' in the label.
